title: Self-Pay Visit Package Reinstatement Charge
content:
**Billing office memo — reinstatement charge, Self-Pay Visit Package.** The reinstatement charge is the tier's reinstatement fee, charged once at the flat amount. The charge is stated to the cent and is never below $0.00.

**The clause in parts**

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Amount | the reinstatement fee of the package's tier |
| How often | once per reinstatement, at the flat amount |
| Precision | to the cent |
| Floor | never below $0.00 |

**Basis questions**

*Is the reinstatement fee charged per restored visit?* No. It is charged once, at the flat amount of the tier's fee.

*Which tier's fee applies?* The fee of the tier of the package being reinstated.

*Worked figure (hypothetical tier fee of $40.00):* the reinstatement charge is $40.00, collected once.
